title: Africa–Asia bauxite exports
note: Aluminium ores and concentrates (HS 2606). This is the heading aggregate and the customs series for bauxite. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. Customs weight is not contained aluminium metal and is not mine production. Mine production is absent from this database, not zero. This is not alumina (HS 281820) and not unwrought aluminium (HS 7601). Net weight and quantity can both be kilograms and still differ; they must not be substituted. The Pink Sheet extract has no bauxite series. Its Aluminum series is metal, not bauxite, and is not stored. A missing price is not zero.
